data.name: DarkOrbit Reloaded
data.detailed_description:
Humanity’s reckless use of Jump Gates triggered a brutal alien retaliation that almost annihilated Earth. In the aftermath, three rival conglomerates emerged: Earth Industries Corporation (EIC), Mars Mining Operations (MMO), and Venus Resources Unlimited (VRU). For generations, their strife has cloaked  the stars in a never-ending fog of war!

 

Dark Orbit is a long-running free-to-play space MMO. Join the fray today and battle for dominance across a fractured galaxy alongside millions of players!

 

  • CHOOSE YOUR ALLEGIANCE and become an elite pilot!

  • CUSTOMIZE YOUR SHIP from a wide variety of designs, outfitting it with drones, weapons, generators, and specialized equipment.

  • TRADE VALUABLE RESOURCES like Prometium, Endurium, Terbium and many more!

  • BID ON ELITE ITEMS and auction off spare loot to gain the upper hand!

  • EPIC MAIN QUEST: Explore the dark history behind the three conglomerates and uncover a galactic conspiracy threatening the fabric of the whole universe!

  • THE LORDAKIA ARE WATCHING: Encounter a wide variety of alien species from all over the universe!

  • BUILD GALAX GATES to access hidden sectors and make your way through a whole new galaxy!

  • Uncover RARE REWARDS!

  • VISIT YOUR SKYLAB to allocate resources and fine-tune your gameplay strategy!

 

Whether you're diving into PvP combat or tackling PvE missions, DarkOrbit offers a sprawling universe filled with danger, intrigue, and opportunity. Will you rise through the ranks and lead your company beyond the final frontier?

data.short_description: Dark Orbit is a free-2-play space MMO where three companies battle for galactic domination. Customize ships, trade resources, fight aliens and uncover a grand conspiracy on your epic cosmic journey. Thrilling PvP and PvE missions await! Will you lead your faction beyond the final frontier?
